status: development after v3-v10 inspection; no preregistered or independent confirmation claim
algorithm: Use a fixed measurement-defined anchor: released dimensionless T for Binder/Wielek, original theta/alpha uHNDI for absolute-power Mendeley. Robustly squash supplementary profile features, residualize on both train-normalized strong baseline scores, then learn an eta-bounded correction with near-anchor-pair weighted logistic loss and ridge. Same training algorithm and search grid for all cohorts. No anchor selection using labels or outer results.
anchor_limit: Assignment follows available measurement units but was chosen after earlier outcomes were seen; it is a disclosed developmental design decision. Wielek's upstream raw-EEG stage classifier is unavailable, so dimensionless stage proportions do not imply demonstrated end-to-end raw-voltage gain invariance.

binder.definition: Per-common-channel envelope reconstructed along exact published time/frequency trajectory and [-.05,.10] averaging offsets. Late[.20,.35] mean T, baseline[-.30,-.05] mean R, early[.02,.15] mean F.
binder.features: Eight late T divided by eight-channel mean minus1 (all-zero->0); eight hndi(T,R,F); eight within-late-sample coefficient of variation (mean0->0). Original T and original uHNDI retained separately, since the original envelope uses a different available-channel set.
binder.boundary: Aggregate ITPC with500ms window and overlapping envelope samples, not raw voltage or independent trials; no clinical latency-resolution claim.

wielek.features: Four non-N1 occupancies; for each destination/source state, (N1-edge count - number_N1_edges * subject stage occupancy)/(number_N1_edges+4). Incoming/outgoing conditioned on N1 with valid chronological edges only.
wielek.boundary: Do not bridge time_record changes or nonconsecutive epoch time. Zero supporting N1 edges yields zero conditional departure, not fabricated epochs. Pseudocount is heuristic contraction, not a calibrated posterior or independent-epoch assumption. No eye/video/CRS-R/clinical/missing-context metadata.

mendeley.features: Six mean theta divided by six-channel theta mean minus1; six hndi(mean_theta,mean_alpha,0); six medians and six IQRs of chronological per-block channel hndi(theta,alpha,0). No sorting before chronological/QC validation; sorting in quantile summaries is only marginal aggregation.
mendeley.source_check: Re-read original41retained EDFs preload=True on historical whole-record sampling grid, six-channel average reference, original4s Welch and500uV QC. Verify raw EDF SHA againstv3, every block peak and channel-average theta/alpha against chronologicalv3cache, and retained count/global means against original store. No new exclusions.

objective: Pairwise log loss weighted exp(-anchor_margin^2/(2*pair_width^2)), normalized over positive-negative training pairs, plus ridge*beta_squared/2. Log weights shifted by maximum for stable normalization.
residualization: Training-only robust median/IQR (std/1 fallback), tanh supplementary features, least-squares projection on [1,asinh(T_normalized),asinh(uHNDI_normalized)]. This removes only the specified training trend, not all statistical/causal dependence. Divide residual features by sqrt(numberfeatures).
bound: Within a fitted model, anchor margins >2eta cannot reverse; no AUC or population-generalization guarantee.
selection: Mean3-inner-fold AUC, ties within1e-12 prefer eta0, then smaller eta/stronger ridge. eta0 represented once with strongest ridge; no reliability gating based on outer outcomes.
inputs: All multifeature methods get exactly T, originaluHNDI and the same explicit profiles; profiles-only excludes the anchor from output but uses it for declared residualization and pair weighting, so this is correction-only rather than independence-from-baselines evidence.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC then equal-weight cohort macro; all adverse seeds/cohorts and ablations retained
performance_target: Positive macro delta over T and originaluHNDI at everyseed; positive5-seed mean cohort delta over both in eachcohort; positive macro mean delta over measurement_anchor. Profile-input advantage must additionally be compared with same-input classical and recent methods before any algorithm superiority claim.
novelty_limit: Candidate target-conditioned representation and bounded, ambiguity-focused ranking combination; constituent operations are not claimed as unprecedented. Iterative inspected-cohort results require future independent confirmation. Earlier sources/results/manuscripts remain byte-protected.
